mapper.select: SELECT DATE(sys_ai_usage_call_time) AS statDate, sys_ai_usage_group_name AS groupName, sys_ai_usage_provider AS provider, sys_ai_usage_model AS model, COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, COALESCE(SUM(sys_ai_usage_prompt_tokens), 0) AS totalPromptTokens, COALESCE(SUM(sys_ai_usage_completion_tokens), 0) AS totalCompletionTokens, COALESCE(SUM(sys_ai_usage_total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(sys_ai_usage_total_cost), 0) AS totalCost, COALESCE(SUM(sys_ai_usage_cached_tokens), 0) AS totalCachedTokens, COALESCE(SUM(sys_ai_usage_total_latency), 0) AS totalLatency FROM sys_ai_usage WHERE sys_ai_usage_call_time >= #{startTime} AND sys_ai_usage_call_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(sys_ai_usage_call_time), sys_ai_usage_group_name, sys_ai_usage_provider, sys_ai_usage_model ORDER BY statDate
